summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. disclosed via Form 6-K a Material Fact that its controlling shareholder, Banco Santander, S.A., intends to launch voluntary exchange tender offers in Brazil and the U.S. to acquire all outstanding common shares, preferred shares, units, and ADSs not already owned by Banco Santander. Holders tendering would receive Banco Santander BDRs or ADSs at an exchange ratio of 0.2028 per share or 0.4056 per unit/ADS, implying a 15% premium based on July 30, 2026 closing prices and a BRL/EUR rate of 5.8461. The ratio is subject to antidilution adjustments for dividends, interest on equity, and splits, but not for buybacks. The offers are conditional on CVM registration of Banco Santander as a foreign issuer, BDR program registration, and BDR admission to trading. Santander Brazil will remain listed on B3; ADSs may be delisted from the NYSE and deregistered with the SEC depending on U.S. offer results. Watch for tender conditions, regulatory approvals, and the implications for ADS liquidity; risk-arb focuses on the exchange ratio's floating value tied to Banco Santander's share price.
